\section*{Answer Key}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item Solve $2x - 14 = 0$. Add $14$ to both sides: $2x = 14$.
        Divide by $2$: $x = 7$.\\
        Final answer: $\boxed{7}$
  \item Compute $9.02 / 2$. Halve $9.02$ (note: problem 1 gave $7$, problem
        3 gives $5$ — distractors for the binding gate).\\
        Final answer: $\boxed{4.51}$
  \item Solve $3x - 15 = 0$: $3x = 15$, so $x = 5$.\\
        Final answer: $\boxed{5.00}$
\end{enumerate}
